description: One-call domain overview: registration (RDAP age, expiry, registrar, DNSSEC), DNS (A/AAAA/NS/MX/CAA), email security (SPF, DMARC policy, 0-100 score, issues) and HTTPS/TLS (reachable, HSTS, cert issuer and days left), with merged flags, an 'attention' list and a verdict: ok, check (risk flags found) or incomplete (a data source did not answer; listed in 'incomplete'). Use to vet or monitor a domain with a single paid request. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).
name: domain_overview
